Name: D3 · Lecco Wednesday market — Piazza Garibaldi
Notes: D3 alternative, 07:30-14:00, 50+ stalls. Runs 4 Mar - 25 Nov 2026. Wednesday 7 October falls perfectly in your stay.

Name: D5 · Cristauta / Praplan — fully-on-foot Seceda start
Notes: D5 hardcore option. Trail 4 up to the ridge — but with FERMEDA CLOSED it's a +900-1,000 m climb with no shortcut. Real, but a big first day in the mountains.

Name: D6 · Geisler Alm / Rifugio delle Odle
SearchQuery: Geisler Alm Rifugio delle Odle Villnoss
Notes: D6. You flagged this as a 'no go' — I'd push back gently. It's directly ON the Adolf Munkel Weg, so you pass its door regardless. The busy/commercial complaint is a high-summer problem. THE REAL RISK IS THAT IT'S SHUT — October season unverified.

Name: D8 · Segra Sacun market — Ortisei, 12 Oct only
Notes: D8 FALLBACK, 08:00-16:00. The biggest traditional market of the year — food stalls, crafts, and a tradition of men giving women a decorated pear. CLASHES with the 08:00 Great Dolomites Road start; you can't have both. Take it if you want a slow morning or it rains.

Name: D9 · Lago di Misurina — 10-minute stop
Notes: D9. Directly on the Tre Cime road and you pass it twice — take whichever light is better. The Grand Hotel Misurina reflected with the Sorapis group behind. Col de Varda chairlift closed 20 Sep.

Name: D10 · Lago di Sorapis — FLEX day, from the hotel door
SearchQuery: Lago di Sorapis Passo Tre Croci
Notes: FLEX. Trailhead is at Passo Tre Croci. 11.5 km out-and-back, ~500 m, ~4h. TRAIL 215 HAS CABLED EXPOSED LEDGES, METAL LADDERS AND POLISHED ROCK, all north/east-facing and shaded — ICED LADDERS ARE A REAL OCTOBER RISK. Rif. Vandelli closed 20 Sep: no water, shelter or toilet. Mildest driest day only, mid-morning start, CARRY MICROSPIKES, turn back if there's ice. Ask the hotel the night before.

Name: D11 · Monte Mondeval from Passo Giau — full-day option
Notes: D11 alternative. 12.8 km, ~5h, moderate, open and panoramic, larch-rich. A full-day substitute for the Lagazuoi/Cinque Torri pair.

Name: D11 · Val Travenanzes descent from Lagazuoi
Notes: D11 alternative. Cable car up, walk down a wild hanging valley to Ponte Outo on the SR48 — 4-5h, mostly descent, some cabled steps near the forcella. NEEDS A CAR SHUTTLE.
